vocabulary.meaning_en: to forgive someone; to overlook a small mistake
to not pay attention to a small problem; to ignore it
stopping being angry with someone for something they did
feeling sad or bad about something; used to apologize
vocabulary.note_en: It is an adjective: I'm sorry.
vocabulary.example: I'm sorry I broke your cup.

vocabulary.meaning_en: words that say you are sorry
to say you are sorry; more formal than "sorry"
vocabulary.note_en: apologize for something; UK also apologise

vocabulary.meaning_en: to stop someone while they are talking or working
vocabulary.example: Sorry to interrupt, but your taxi is here.

vocabulary.meaning_en: when someone looks at or listens to you
vocabulary.note_ar: get someone's attention = يلفت انتباه شخص
vocabulary.example: He waved to get the waiter's attention.

vocabulary.meaning_en: feeling sorry for someone who has a problem
vocabulary.example: I'm sorry to hear about your accident. You have my sympathy.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a feeling of worry or sadness
vocabulary.example: The bad news caused her great distress.

vocabulary.note_en: a sorry situation, a sorry excuse for a school
vocabulary.example: The old building was in a sorry state.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to forgive; also "Pardon?" = What did you say?
vocabulary.example: Pardon? Can you repeat that, please?

vocabulary.meaning_en: to feel sad about something you did or didn't do, often a lost chance
vocabulary.example: I regret not learning English earlier.

vocabulary.meaning_en: deep sympathy when someone has died
vocabulary.note_ar: تُستخدم للوفاة أو الأمور الخطيرة فقط
vocabulary.note_en: Only for death or very serious things.
vocabulary.example: My condolences on the loss of your father.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to treat someone badly or unfairly
vocabulary.example: I wronged my friend, and I want to say sorry.

fine_lines.title: excuse me (before) vs sorry (after)
fine_lines.explanation_ar: excuse me نقولها قبل أن نفعل شيئًا قد يزعج: لجذب الانتباه، أو لمقاطعة شخص، أو لنطلب منه أن يتحرك. sorry نقولها بعد أن نخطئ، وللتعاطف مع خبر سيئ، وعند رفض دعوة.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Say "excuse me" BEFORE you do something: to get attention, interrupt, or ask someone to move. Say "sorry" AFTER you do something wrong, to show sympathy, or to say you can't do something.

examples.sentence: Excuse me, could you move your bag?
Oh, sorry! I stepped on your foot.

fine_lines.title: Sorry? vs Excuse me?
fine_lines.explanation_ar: Sorry? بنبرة سؤال تعني: لم أسمعك، أعد من فضلك. Excuse me? بنبرة قوية قد تعني: لم يعجبني ما قلته!
fine_lines.explanation_en: "Sorry?" = I didn't hear you, please repeat. "Excuse me?" (strong tone) = I don't like what you just said!

examples.sentence: Excuse me? You think my work is bad?

fine_lines.title: sorry vs apologize vs regret
fine_lines.explanation_ar: sorry كلمة يومية عادية. apologize أكثر رسمية وتُظهر أسفًا أكبر. regret تعني الندم على شيء، خاصة على فرصة ضائعة.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Sorry is everyday. Apologize is more formal and stronger. Regret is feeling sad about something, especially a lost chance.

examples.sentence: I regret not taking that job.

fine_lines.title: apologize vs apology
fine_lines.explanation_en: Apologize is a verb; apology is a noun.

expressions.meaning_en: used to get someone's attention politely
expressions.example: Excuse me? Could we have the menu, please?

expressions.phrase: Excuse me, could you move over?
expressions.meaning_ar: لو سمحت، هل يمكنك أن تتحرّك قليلًا؟
expressions.example: Excuse me, could you move over? I need this seat.

expressions.meaning_en: said when you have already interrupted someone
expressions.example: I'm sorry to interrupt, but there's a call for you.
Your grandmother is ill? I'm sorry to hear that.

expressions.meaning_en: saying no to an invitation politely
expressions.example: I'm sorry, I can't come on Friday. I have to work.

expressions.meaning_en: What did you say? Please repeat.
expressions.example: Pardon? Could you say that again?

expressions.meaning_en: said to someone when a person they love has died
expressions.example: I heard about your uncle. My condolences.

expressions.meaning_en: a very bad example of something
expressions.example: This is a sorry excuse for a road; it's full of holes.

grammar.title: Structure: "excuse me" (phrase) vs "sorry" (adjective)
grammar.explanation_ar: excuse me عبارة من فعل (excuse) وضمير (me). أما sorry فهي صفة، لذلك نستخدمها مع to be: I'm sorry. ونقول: sorry for + اسم أو -ing، وsorry to + فعل.
grammar.explanation_en: "Excuse me" is a phrase: verb + me. "Sorry" is an adjective, so we use it with be: I'm sorry. Use sorry for + noun / -ing, and sorry to + verb.

You stepped on someone's foot. What do you say?
questions.explanation_en: After you do something wrong, say sorry.

choices: I didn't hear you. Please repeat.
questions.explanation_ar: Sorry? بنبرة سؤال تعني: لم أسمعك.

"I ___ not studying harder. I lost a good chance."
questions.explanation_ar: regret = يندم، خاصة على فرصة ضائعة.

questions.explanation_ar: sorry قبل الاسم قد تعني سيئ أو بائس.
questions.explanation_en: Before a noun, sorry can mean very bad.
